title: Button Press and Brake Activation Confusion
summary: This topic mostly contains procedural or descriptive mentions of pressing buttons, pedals, or brakes, with only limited evidence of a clearly negative experience involving accidental button activation.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are too brief or procedural to determine sentiment reliably.
